Tagging on a borrowed boat

In my last post on the SC22 outcomes, I wrote about tagging and about SC asking SPC to convene a technical workshop in 2027 on the use of tagging data in regional assessments.

Tagging is a vital tool in the stock assessment toolbox. The results always matter, even when they do not go the way scientists hoped.

Continuity of tagging effort is the sensor on the most valuable renewable resource in the Pacific. Without it, the entire signal chain depends on whether an old pole-and-line boat is free next April.
